caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved, high-necked garment, possibly a jacket or blouse, rendered on a beige background. The main garment is colored in sections of yellow and alternating vertical stripes in red, blue, green, and white. These sections are separated by horizontal and diagonal bands of black lace or patterned trim, creating a segmented appearance across the sleeves and torso. The collar, cuffs, and lower hem are also trimmed with the same black lace. The garment is open at the front, showing a symmetrical split from the neck down. In the upper right corner, a smaller, less detailed line drawing of the same garment is included, displaying the back view and matching the overall composition and style without color or texture.
title: Jacket
